scoring.recall: found / total planted items (an item counts as found if the report contains its substance with correct owner/value/status and a citation that resolves to one of the anchor lines or timestamps)
scoring.precision: grounded / total reported items (a reported item is grounded if its citation resolves and the transcript supports it; hedged speculation, off-record inferences, and invented items are ungrounded)
scoring.traps: each trap is scored pass/fail per its expected handling
